map.SLA 达标率是怎么算的？: How is the SLA compliance rate computed?
map.达标率 = 响应时长 ≤ SLA 目标值的工单数 ÷ 工单总数。本例 SLA=3: The compliance rate is the number of tickets whose response time is within the SLA target divided by the total number of tickets. Here the SLA is 30 minutes and 6 of the 8 tickets are within 30 minutes (45 and 35 minutes over), so the rate is 75.0%.
map.P90、P99 分位响应有什么用？: What are P90 and P99 response percentiles for?
map.P90 表示 90% 的工单响应快于该值，P99 表示 99% 的工单快于该值；: P90 means 90% of tickets respond faster than that value and P99 means 99% are faster. They measure the long-tail experience and expose a few extreme slow cases far better than an average does, which makes them key metrics for SLA governance.
